subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
What average operating noise figure results when the 
amplifier is used with an antenna of temperature 30 
K? 
 
(a) 9.54 dB 
(b) 10.96 dB 
 
(c) 11.23 dB 
(d) 12.96 dB 
 
Common Data for Q.No-15 to 17 
An amplifier has a narrow bandwidth of 1 kHz and 
standard spot noise figure of 3.8 at its frequency of 
operation. The amplifier’s available output noise power is 
0.1 mW when its input is connected to a radio receiving 
antenna having an antenna temperature of 80 K.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-07 (Noise In Communication).
